summary: Card avoidance game where players keep a running total at or below 99 or lose a life.
rules_text: Each player starts with 3 tokens and 3 cards from a 52-card deck. A running total starts at 0. On your turn play one card face up, announce the new total, then draw to 3 cards. Number cards add their number, J/Q/J? Face cards count 10. Specials: 4 reverses direction and adds 0, 9 passes and adds 0, 10 subtracts 10, King sets total to 99, Ace is 1 or 11 chosen by player. Total may never exceed 99. If on your turn you have no legal card that keeps total <=99, you lose one token, the hand ends, and cards are reshuffled and redealt. Players who lose all 3 tokens are eliminated. Last player with tokens remaining wins.
rating_reason: Turn-based counting card game with stakes elimination
